description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of test cases for verifying the behavior of 'git merge' operations in various scenarios. It defines setup steps, tests for conflict detection, file overwrites, untracked files, symbolic links, and behaves with unborn branches, primarily to ensure that git's merge operation handles these cases correctly.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes commands that are expected to fail, verifying correct failure behavior.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks whether given file paths are missing from the filesystem.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or streams.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates symbolic links for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be run after the tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within a file or output.
